title: Let me try first.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I can do it with two hands.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Two hands, then. On the low shelf.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: A little's fine. Next time, even less.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I can do it myself next time.

variations: "pour it" 换 "carry it"；"two hands" 换 "slow steps"。
